model: claude-sonnet-5 (Claude Code session, direct image read, no Anthropic Messages API call)
method: Revised 2026-07-23: the source PDF (inputs/incoming/DEICO_DE4001_TECHNICAL_DRAWING.pdf) was read directly inside a Claude Code conversation, using both the rendered page image and the PDF's embedded text layer (this differs from the original 2026-07-09 pass, which used the rendered image only). A raw JSON response was hand-written against the rules in src/technical_drawing_parser/extraction/prompt.py (build_vlm_prompt) and the schema in product.py, then passed through the real parse_product_json_response and format_json_compact so the final shape matches what the pipeline would produce from that raw response. This revision also fixed a wrong source_file value (was DE4001_Technical_Drawing.pdf, an incorrect approximation of the real filename), an inconsistent superscript in two Target Bus Connector pin descriptions, a paraphrased legal-notice note, and a missing schematics field (added to the schema after the original pass). Because text-layer access is not available to the real image-only VLM call, this file is a hand-derived reference for checking prompt/schema correctness, not a simulation of real Anthropic/Ollama image-only extraction quality (see outputs_claude_code_blind_test/ for that).
purpose: Comparison baseline against outputs_claude_sonnet_test/products/deico_de4001.json (produced via the Anthropic API) without spending API budget or overwriting that result.
